description: Optional OpenTelemetry metrics of a Club Calendar instance. Needs a Prometheus-compatible datasource and a collector with deltatocumulative. See the Notes row.

panels.description: Calendars that are not archived. Hourly value.

panels.title: Events
panels.description: Events that are not drafts. Hourly value.

panels.title: Feeds
panels.description: Feeds of all visibilities. Hourly value.

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Share of failed attempts in the selected range. No data when nobody signed in.

options.content:
**Names.** The app's metrics appear in Prometheus-compatible stores with dots turned into underscores and `_total` added to counters, for example `club_calendar.logins` is `club_calendar_logins_total`.

**Rolling 2 hours.** Sign-ins, feed requests and MCP calls are rare, and the store needs two samples inside a window to compute an increase. The graphs therefore show a rolling 2-hour window: each point is the number of events in the 2 hours before it. Range totals and ratios use the selected time range; ranges shorter than 2 hours can show too little.

**Percentages.** A failure ratio shows 0% when there were attempts but no failures, and "No data" only when there were no attempts at all.

**Feed requests.** Mostly calendar apps polling on a timer, not people. A 304 means "unchanged since last time". Unknown feeds, wrong secrets and rate-limited requests are not counted.

**Hourly and daily values.** Counts of users, clubs, feeds and so on are reported hourly. The per-club, per-calendar and per-feed distributions (avg, min, max, median, stddev) are reported once a day at 03:20 UTC and need the scheduler and a worker.
